{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module ImagePipeline where

import Control.Concurrent.Async (async, wait)
import Control.Monad (when, forM_)
import Data.ByteString.Char8 (ByteString)
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as BS
import Data.IORef
import System.Process (callProcess)
import Data.Char (ord, chr, isAlphaNum)
import Data.List (isPrefixOf, isInfixOf)
import System.IO (hClose, hSetBinaryMode)
import System.IO.Temp (withSystemTempFile)

-- Image processing job metadata
data ImageJob = ImageJob
  { jobId        :: Int
  , jobOwnerEmail :: ByteString
  , jobFormat    :: ByteString
  , jobCallback  :: ByteString
  , jobPayload   :: ByteString
  } deriving (Show)

-- Notification envelope
data Envelope = Envelope
  { envTo      :: ByteString
  , envFrom    :: ByteString
  , envSubject :: ByteString
  , envHeaders :: [ByteString]
  , envBody    :: ByteString
  } deriving (Show)

-- Strict email validation - only allow safe characters
validateEmailStrict :: ByteString -> Maybe ByteString
validateEmailStrict input =
  let str = BS.unpack input
      isValidEmailChar c = isAlphaNum c || c `elem` ("@._+-" :: String)
      hasAtSign = '@' `elem` str
      hasDot = '.' `elem` str
      allValid = all isValidEmailChar str
      noControl = all (\c -> ord c >= 32 && ord c < 127) str
  in if allValid && hasAtSign && hasDot && noControl && length str < 255
     then Just input
     else Nothing

-- Sanitize checks for injection in header values
sanitizeHeader :: ByteString -> Bool
sanitizeHeader val =
  let str = BS.unpack val
  in not (BS.elem '\n' val) &&
     not (BS.elem '\r' val) &&
     all (\c -> ord c >= 32 && ord c < 127) str

-- Build notification after image processing completes
buildNotification :: ImageJob -> ByteString -> Maybe Envelope
buildNotification job status = do
  recipientValidated <- validateEmailStrict (jobOwnerEmail job)
  let subject = BS.concat ["Image Job #", BS.pack (show (jobId job)), " - ", status]
      body = BS.concat ["Your image processing job has completed.\nFormat: ", jobFormat job]
      callbackHeader = BS.concat ["X-Callback-URL: ", jobCallback job]
  Just $ Envelope
    { envTo = recipientValidated
    , envFrom = "noreply@imageservice.internal"
    , envSubject = subject
    , envHeaders = [callbackHeader]
    , envBody = body
    }

-- Serialize envelope to sendmail-compatible format
serializeEnvelope :: Envelope -> ByteString
serializeEnvelope env =
  BS.intercalate "\r\n" $
    [ BS.concat ["To: ", envTo env]
    , BS.concat ["From: ", envFrom env]
    , BS.concat ["Subject: ", envSubject env]
    ] ++ envHeaders env ++
    [ ""
    , envBody env
    ]

-- Validate envelope before sending
validateEnvelope :: Envelope -> Bool
validateEnvelope env =
  sanitizeHeader (envTo env) &&
  sanitizeHeader (envFrom env) &&
  sanitizeHeader (envSubject env) &&
  all sanitizeHeader (envHeaders env)

-- Process image asynchronously and send notification
processAndNotify :: ImageJob -> IO (Either String ())
processAndNotify job = do
  -- Async image processing
  processResult <- async $ processImage (jobPayload job) (jobFormat job)
  result <- wait processResult
  case result of
    Left err -> return (Left err)
    Right _ -> do
      case buildNotification job "Complete" of
        Nothing -> return (Left "Invalid recipient email")
        Just envelope ->
          if validateEnvelope envelope
            then do
              sendNotification envelope
              return (Right ())
            else return (Left "Invalid envelope headers")

-- Simulated image processing
processImage :: ByteString -> ByteString -> IO (Either String ByteString)
processImage payload fmt
  | BS.null payload = return (Left "Empty payload")
  | otherwise = return (Right $ BS.concat ["processed_", fmt, "_", BS.take 16 payload])

-- Send via local MTA
sendNotification :: Envelope -> IO ()
sendNotification env = do
  let message = serializeEnvelope env
  -- Use a securely-created, uniquely-named temp file with private permissions
  -- (withSystemTempFile creates the file with 0600 and a unique name),
  -- avoiding symlink attacks and cross-job file clobbering.
  withSystemTempFile "outgoing_mail.eml" $ \_path h -> do
    hSetBinaryMode h True
    BS.hPutStr h message
    hClose h
    -- In production: callProcess "sendmail" ["-t"] fed from this file
    return ()

-- Entry point for the pipeline
runPipeline :: [ImageJob] -> IO [Either String ()]
runPipeline jobs = do
  asyncResults <- mapM (async . processAndNotify) jobs
  mapM wait asyncResults
